name: The Family Sin
source:
Assume the role of a teenager starting a new life in one of the oldest and most remote cities. You begin a fairly normal life, with a new school year and a new job to help support your family.
Explore and uncover the secrets of the mind, and observe how different mental manipulation techniques affect those around you.
